items.item_text: 3-5 years recent acute care experience in critical care (ICU) nursing practice with demonstrated leadership experience

Assesses educational needs in close consultation with Critical Care/Emergency Services leadership and staff, conducting annual formal needs assessments and presenting findings and proposed plans for approval

Evaluates educational projects and safety initiatives against agreed-upon outcomes, regularly reporting progress to Emergency Services leadership, Market Chief Nurses, and Patient Safety/Clinical Risk Management
Revises work goals, methods, and processes to support evidence-based practice and quality care, ensuring alignment with nursing strategies, values, and departmental/facility priorities
Collaborates with market leaders to drive 100% implementation of Critical Care/ED safety initiatives and other patient safety projects
Reviews data and processes to evaluate compliance with safety initiatives, regulatory requirements, and hospital policies
Supports market roll-out of safety projects and goals, and develops, implements, and facilitates learning opportunities such as Mock Codes, disaster preparedness, and critical incident simulations
Current and Active Registered Nurse: CA
